Author: G. He et al.
Title: Environment-Adaptive Online Learning for Portable Energy Storage Based on Porous Electrode Model
Venue: IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering, Vol. 22

State_Space: Remaining energy; inventory energy cost; locational marginal price; node temperature; battery SOH; current node; current time period
Action_Type: Destination node; charging mode; charging or discharging power level
Reward_Function:
If charging: negative transport cost − negative degradation cost (no immediate revenue; charging cost treated as inventory to encourage exploration)

Statistical Validation: Results presented as single-run average reward curves and bar chart revenues only.
